front.title: Identity Continuation Assertion for OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange

abstract.t: This document defines the Identity Continuation Assertion, a short- lived, sender-constrained JWT used as an OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange subject token. It lets an Identity Provider (IdP) issue an onward Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant (ID-JAG) when a user's request crosses service boundaries after the user is no longer present. The profile targets deployments in which several Resource Authorization Servers trust one IdP and use audience-local subject identifiers that only the IdP can resolve. It complements offline attenuation for intra-domain fan-out that does not change the subject.
